title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: Surrender
desc: Across five days, prior to the election season, political conflicts lead to complications for a notorious gangster and the police.

title: Odela 2
desc: When a rapist is improperly buried, his ghost begins haunting his village and attacking innocent women. As chaos arises, the villagers look for an answer.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Aranmanai
desc: A family returns to their hometown to sell their ancestral palace. However, their arrival is marred by supernatural events, and Ravi, a relative of the family, decides to uncover the truth.
